report.label_source: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 (reference map; not field truth)
report.split: Spatial groups, 16 x 16 analysis cells (~960 m blocks). 60% fit / 20% validation / 20% held-out test. Final model refit on development blocks.
report.caveat: Held-out agreement with a dated reference map, not independently verified field accuracy. Later years are temporal transfer predictions, not validated rehabilitation outcomes.

sources.role: Planned radar integration. No NISAR measurements used to train this optical model.

limitations: Model predicts land cover at an observed date, not future yield or time to recovery.
Reference-map agreement is not field validation. Built surfaces and exposed soil can be confused.
No verified mine, restoration intervention, farm boundary, planting record, soil chemistry, groundwater depth or measured crop health is supplied.
Analysis sectors are regular grid summaries, not cadastral parcels.
Anomaly scores compare optical features with the 2021 vegetated reference and are not a crop diagnosis.
Cross-year observations are from broadly similar months, but planting and weather conditions may differ.
Water layer maps surface extent. No measured water depth or reservoir level is supplied.
